linear_title: Browser-test quote comparison, sourcing filter, freshness and vendor links
linear_description:
## Context
Verified on #564 (084b48c5):
- src/features/quotes/client-workspace-fixtures.ts has no geographic_origin values. Every fixture offer therefore resolves to 'unknown' through resolveDomesticStatus (src/features/quotes/selection.ts:214-219), and the US-only sourcing filter never runs in a browser.
- Variant grouping, stale/expired offer handling, the sourcing filter and vendor links have unit coverage only (gap map G9, G10).
- Fixture scenarios form a closed list: CLIENT_WORKSPACE_FIXTURE_SCENARIOS (:247-279) and SCENARIO_BUILDERS (:1661-1667).
- The fixture lane picks up @fixture specs in e2e/ automatically, and CI runs `npm run e2e:fixture`.

## Scope
Add a 'client-comparison' scenario, with a new builder; existing scenarios stay unchanged. Its canonical path is a part route. Its offers must satisfy the trusted-live rules (allowlisted provider, 14-day freshness) except where noted:
- Xometry with 3 domestic variants of one item;
- one foreign Fictiv offer;
- one offer with no origin;
- one offer with no lead time;
- one offer quoted more than 14 days ago (stale);
- one expired offer;
- HTTPS vendor URLs throughout.

Add a new spec, `e2e/quote-comparison.spec.ts` (@fixture), at 1440x900 and 390x844. Add a new unit test for the builder; do not edit client-workspace-fixtures.test.ts, which #570 edits.

Assertions use roles and text only, never colour classes:
- (a) The Xometry variants are grouped under one provider entry with 3 variants.
- (b) Selecting an offer row selects the same offer in the comparison chart or table, in both directions where both exist.
- (c) If the part route renders a comparison chart, it plots points only, with no line or area series.
- (d) US-only hides the foreign offer and 'all' shows it. The no-origin offer is labelled Unknown, never domestic; record how the current filter treats it.
- (e) A missing lead time is shown as not available and is never ranked fastest.
- (f) Stale and expired offers are neither shown as live nor selectable. Positive control: a fresh offer in the same scenario is live and selectable.
- (g) Vendor links use https with rel containing noopener. Assert the current attributes. Assert the sign-in note only if the UI renders one; otherwise record its absence.
- (h) The decision panel contains no order, checkout or payment control. The locator is scoped to the panel, and nothing is asserted about the legacy procurement handoff (Q21).
- (i) Keyboard only, at 1440: Tab reaches the first quote row, Enter or Space selects it, the focused element shows a visible focus indicator, and Tab reaches the vendor link.
- At 390x844: the comparison has no horizontal overflow, and tap selection works.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The new spec passes, client-shell.spec.ts still passes, and the whole e2e:fixture lane passes.
- [ ] Mutations run on scratch copies only, and each is recorded:
  - missing origin mapped to 'domestic' makes (d) fail;
  - grouping disabled makes (a) fail;
  - a widened freshness window makes (f) fail.
- [ ] The spec passes on a scratch merge of #564+#567+#569+#570.
- [ ] There are no product-code changes. If an assertion exposes a defect, stop and report it; do not fix it here.
- [ ] The CI fixture step is green.

## Verification commands
```bash
flock /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock sudo -u ubuntu -H env PATH=$PATH PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_AUTH_SETUP=1 npx playwright test --grep @fixture e2e/quote-comparison.spec.ts e2e/client-shell.spec.ts
flock /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock sudo -u ubuntu -H env PATH=$PATH PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers npm run e2e:fixture
npx vitest run src/features/quotes src/components/quotes/ClientQuoteDecisionPanel.test.tsx
npm run lint && npm run typecheck
flock /tmp/ovd-verify.lock npm run verify
```

## Out of scope
- U8 currency (Q18) and U12 refresh/requote (Q29).
- In-session requirement invalidation (Q29).
- The legacy procurement handoff (Q21).
- The axe scan (Q27, Q28).
- Colour and contrast.

Parent: OVD-319
guidance:
COMMON RULES (all units):
(1) Worktree: `git -C /home/user/Overdrafter fetch origin && git -C /home/user/Overdrafter worktree add /home/user/wt/quotecmp -b <branch> origin/codex/recovered-release-free-safety-20261003`. Never edit /home/user/Overdrafter.
(2) Run `npm ci`.
(3) Locks, in this order: /tmp/ovd-supabase.lock, then /tmp/ovd-e2e.lock (every Playwright run), then /tmp/ovd-verify.lock. Run `flock /tmp/ovd-replay.lock true` before Playwright.
(4) Run Playwright as ubuntu with the sandbox on: `chmod -R a+rwX /home/user/wt/quotecmp`, then `sudo -u ubuntu -H env PATH=$PATH PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers ...`.
(5) Commit trailers per ENV.md. No force-push.
(6) The PR title starts with this unit's issue ID. Never write the parent ID anywhere.
(7) No new copy.
(8) The scenario builder must be strict-null clean (#570). Import nothing #567 deletes (QuoteChart, QuoteList, QuoteStatBar, use-toast and the rest).
(9) Do not edit .sonarcloud.properties.
(10) Cite G9 and G10 plus ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md lines. Never claim U10-U13 or R7/R8/R12 are complete (Q13).

STEPS
1. Read the existing builders, buildQuotedScenario at :1201 in particular, plus the trusted-live and selection logic in selection.ts. Then build the new scenario so that only the stale and expired offers fail the freshness rules.
2. Find the scenario consumers with `git grep -n CLIENT_WORKSPACE_FIXTURE_SCENARIOS`. If a test or the fixture panel enumerates the scenarios or their count, update it minimally and note the likely merge with #570.
3. Open the canonical path in the fixture lane and map the real surface:
   - which component renders the comparison on /parts/:id;
   - whether a chart exists;
   - where the vendor link sits.
   Write assertions only for behaviour the UI implements today.
4. For the focus check, read getComputedStyle on document.activeElement: outline-style is not 'none', or box-shadow is not 'none'.
5. For the overflow check, assert document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= window.innerWidth.
6. Mutations, each in a scratch edit that is never committed:
   - resolveDomesticStatus returns 'domestic' for non-foreign values;
   - disable the variant-grouping function;
   - widen the freshness window to 400 days.
   Run the spec after each and record the failing assertion.
7. Scratch merge in a throwaway worktree:
   - `git merge --no-commit origin/refactor/OVD-595-production-bundle-cleanup origin/fix/OVD-596-mobile-nav-escape origin/refactor/OVD-594-web-strict-null-checks`;
   - run `npm ci` if the lock changed;
   - run the spec and record the result;
   - remove the worktree.

Schedule: lane B, order 4. This run needs no DB lock.
failure_first:
There is no product change, so the falsifiers are recorded mutations:
(1) Missing origin mapped to 'domestic' makes the US-only and Unknown assertions in (d) fail.
(2) Grouping disabled makes the 3-variant assertion in (a) fail.
(3) A freshness window widened to 400 days makes the stale-not-selectable assertion in (f) fail.

The positive control in (f) and the fresh-offer selection must pass in the same run. That proves 'not selectable' does not pass vacuously, for example because every offer is treated as a recommendation.
